value.note: All injected-fault, concurrency and supersede outcomes below are observations, not predeclared 409/500 or atomicity assertions.

value.setup: Root uses real upload/link producers for source Lead, including active latest, final-only nonlatest, inactive link/attachment and exact finance/internal-assessment category controls.
selection: Copy only active source links and active is_latest attachment; default query does not copy a final-only nonlatest version.
Exclude exactly finance and internal-assessment; do not apply a substring/category permission rule.
Existing active identical attachment/target/relation is skipped; new target relation is source; original Lead links remain.
cuts: Capture all parent/link/snapshot/audit/session writes between copy source reads and final explicit em.flush.
Deny INSERT attachment_link, then INSERT audit_log at the attachment-copy audit stage, then INSERT lead_score_snapshot, each on a fresh real qualified Lead.
Record the target project counter before/after, actual attempted versus unattempted SQL groups, full final Lead/Project/link graph, audit copiedCount/requestId and transaction/connection identities.
Observe no-copy case: copy audit is not called when no eligible new links exist; do not manufacture an audit failure boundary there.
value.unknownOutcomes: Status, mid-flush point and rollback/commit surface require Root Native evidence; no result is asserted here.
